book_title: 小蓝本高中卷4 均值不等式与柯西不等式
stem_md:
设 $x_{i} \geqslant 1 (i = 1, 2, \cdots, n)$, 证明: 
$$
\frac{\prod (x_{i} - 1)}{\prod x_{i}} = \left(\prod \frac{x_{i} - 1}{x_{i}}\right)^{\frac{1}{n}} \leqslant \frac{1}{n} \sum \frac{x_{i} - 1}{x_{i}} = 1 - \frac{1}{n} \sum \frac{1}{x_{i}}.
$$
以及
$$
\frac{1}{n} \sum \frac{1}{x_{i}} \geqslant \frac{n}{\sum x_{i}}.
$$
从而可知命题成立.
